canonical_name: No Input and Output Storage Controls
description: The entity does not implement policies and procedures to store inputs, items in processing, and outputs completely, accurately, and timely in accordance with system specifications.

metadata.detection_notes: Review data storage policies, archival procedures, retention controls, storage validation processes, and data integrity checks. Check for absence of storage controls, retention policies, or data integrity verification.
